description: This file defines the GatewayConnectivityCoordinator class responsible for managing gateway endpoint connectivity, observing endpoint state changes, and handling URL information within the OpenClaw project for macOS.

classes.name: GatewayConnectivityCoordinator
classes.description: Main class managing the connection status and endpoint information for gateway connectivity, including observing state updates and logging.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the endpoint subscription task if not already active, listening for endpoint state updates.

methods.name: handleEndpointState
methods.description: Handles updates to the endpoint state, updating internal properties and triggering refresh actions on changes.

methods.name: hostLabel
methods.description: Generates a user-friendly label for a URL's host, including port if present.
